name: Linker Hand O6
summary: Linker Hand O6 is LinkerBot's compact linkage-driven five-finger hand for humanoids, handling, assembly and irregular-object grasping. description.en: Linker Hand O6 is LinkerBot's compact linkage-driven five-finger hand for humanoids, handling, assembly and irregular-object grasping. It combines six active and five passive degrees of freedom in a manufacturer-listed 360 g package. The product description emphasizes low end-effector mass and integration with different robot arms. The specification lists CAN, CAN FD, RS485 and EtherCAT interfaces, with tactile sensing optional. Published force values distinguish the thumb, other fingertips and combined five-finger grip; the advertised maximum load should not be read as a continuous active lifting rating.
